corrected_value.title: Sex Differences: A Study of the Eye of the Beholder

decisions.quote: This was tested using a conceptual replication of an influential gender label study by Condry and Condry in which participants viewed a video of a baby crying in response to a startling event. Contrary to the Condry findings, this study found that participant perception of why a baby was crying was not consistent with the gender label given (consistent, being angry for the boy label and fearful for the girl label). Participant ratings did not vary significantly based on the gender label.
decisions.reason: The exact primary abstract names Condry/Condry and the boy-label anger/girl-label fear crying-infant experiment, matching shipped2345; missing title/year in blind coding and earlier Luna misreading do not make a new paper. Parent independently read the primary description and all supplied shipped identities. Bind the existing original, without adding a duplicate pair or inferring an unrequested outcome.
